title: the secret pre-commit hook rejects a credential-shaped value sharing a line with a placeholder marker, while a genuine placeholder value stays allowed

criteria.given: a synthetic GitHub-token-shaped value on a line that also carries an unrelated placeholder marker (a process.env reference, a trailing example/test comment)
criteria.then: scripts/check-secrets.sh rejects the file: the placeholder exemption applies to the matched credential value, not to any text elsewhere on the line

criteria.given: a fixture whose credential-shaped value itself is a placeholder (xxxx padding, the AWS documentation example key)
criteria.then: scripts/check-secrets.sh accepts it — the documented placeholder allowance survives, narrowed to the value it describes

criteria.given: the ci / flake-policy job runs node --test over the .github/scripts/*.test.mjs glob
criteria.then: the regression test ships as .github/scripts/check-secrets.test.mjs, so the existing job discovers and runs it without a workflow edit
